categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Adds SharedMutex, SharedLock, and non-LIFO lock tracking to src/sync.h and src/sync.cpp.
categories.rationale: The PR introduces general-purpose shared mutex and lock wrappers along with lock-order debugging support into Bitcoin Core's synchronization utilities. In utils, locking primitives are foundational infrastructure where subtle concurrency issues can cause node-wide problems.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Labeled UTXO Db and Indexes, modifying src/txdb.cpp and src/txdb.h to synchronize coins database cursors and cache resizing.
categories.rationale: The change prevents node crashes caused by AssumeUTXO cache rebalancing destroying active LevelDB iterators. As described, long-running RPCs like gettxoutsetinfo or scantxoutset keep iterators open after releasing cs_main, causing LevelDB to abort if ResizeCache() replaces m_db concurrently.
